ns2:course.label: Memory and Amnesia
ns2:course.description: (PSYCH 303) Examination of the nature of amnesia and what it teaches us about the organization of normal human memory. Coverage will include studies of amnesia and other circumscribed memory impairments in human patients, and other neuroscientific and cognitive explorations of memory prompted by the phenomena of amnesia. Same as NEUR 303. Prerequisite: PSYC 210 and/or PSYC 224, or consent of instructor
